question: Which smaller MoE artifacts execute correctly on the phone, and what are resident versus streamed CPU latency, throughput and RSS?
primary_prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining why the sky appears blue during the day.
distinct_prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining how plants use sunlight to grow.
order: Resident/streamed on even pairs; streamed/resident on odd pairs. Warmup excluded from aggregates.
parity: Exact prompt IDs, output IDs, output bytes and all retained float-logit bytes within each matched pair; no tolerance widening.
reference_scope: Same pinned patched backend with materializer disabled, not a pristine unpatched upstream binary. Resident extra CPU buffer selection differs from streaming as shipped and is disclosed.
cache: Fresh processes; OS cache uncontrolled. Artifact SHA verification precedes inference and warms file cache. No cold-storage claim.
hashing: Host and phone model SHA256 checked; streaming additionally verifies its retained descriptor. Per-process wall includes streaming hashing, inference timings exclude it.
limits: Short text characterization only, not quality or long-context qualification
No API queuing or continuous batching performance claim

liquid_slot_amendment.basis: Metadata/source preflight before Liquid execution; no failed 64-slot Liquid run

publication_scope: Report, graphs, artifact identities and aggregate results only. Detailed device logs, probe snapshots, individual measurements, logit hashes and full replay scripts remain local. Public files cannot independently reproduce aggregation from raw trials.
